description.text: Note: The specialty is conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 15 students for Bachelor’s degree. Before applying, pls contact SICAS for the latest information. Program Objectives The course aims to produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficientin Asia as well as in the rest of the world. To graduate, a student must successfully earnthe required number of credits in each of eight groups, and at least 140 credits in total,including those from internships and an optional applied research project. Why choose these programs The programs emphasize personal development and the acquisition of business skills to: 1. ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards ofpersonal excellence; 2. introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help themexpand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society; 3. ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative andmeaningful solutions; 4. enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork.After graduation, students will be awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA).

duration.text: The Business Administration at Weifang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1527 USD/per year ￥ 11000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3. High school's certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 3. Applicants must Be in good health
